title: Experimental rms nuclear charge radii for the Atomicus natural-isotope catalogue

codataOverrides.reason: Use current CODATA rms charge radii where supplied for H-1, H-2, and He-4; retain the archived IAEA value alongside each override.

interpretation: The input is an experimentally inferred rms charge radius, not a directly measured hard nuclear edge. The renderer uses it only as an explicit packing-envelope cap, without a density-profile conversion.

availability.policy: No radius is derived or imputed. Entries without a positive IAEA/CODATA rms charge radius must not run the nuclear-packing simulation.
